subject: Always log "possibly failing" when a node reaches PFAIL (#4186)
reason: The change only moves a serverLog(LL_NOTICE, "possibly failing") call in clusterCron so it is emitted for voting primaries too, instead of only for non-voting nodes. The PFAIL flag setting, update_state, and markNodeAsFailingIfNeeded logic are unchanged, and the log statement reuses the exact format string and arguments that already existed. It is a log-message-visibility change with no effect on replies, cluster state, failover, replication, or persistence, so no fuzzer oracle (ledger, deployment state, liveness, or a compared command sequence) can observe any difference between the two build
